user.title: OpenVoiceOS
user.description: Pre-filled from your Home Assistant settings where possible — edit anything that doesn't match what you want OVOS to use.

abort.already_configured: Already configured — only one shared config entry is needed.

user.title: Add an OVOS skill
user.description: Pick a skill from the official OVOS catalog to install.

reconfigure_fields.title: Skill settings
reconfigure_fields.description: This skill's settingsmeta.json only uses field types we've confirmed how to map to a real form (checkboxes). If it ever gains other field types, this form will fall back to raw JSON instead.

reconfigure_json.title: Skill settings (raw JSON)
reconfigure_json.description: This skill either has no settingsmeta.json, or uses a field type not yet mapped to a real form — edit its settings.json directly as JSON.

abort.no_api_url: Set the "Skills API URL" text field (under the OpenVoiceOS integration's own entities) to your ovos-skills add-on's address first, e.g. http://<hostname>:8500.
abort.catalog_unreachable: Could not reach the skill catalog via the configured Skills API URL.
abort.unknown_skill: That skill could not be found in the catalog.
abort.install_request_failed: Could not start the install — check that the ovos-skills add-on is running and the Skills API URL is correct.
abort.settings_write_failed: Could not save settings — check that the ovos-skills add-on is running and the Skills API URL is correct.
